content: librqbit (Rust, ikatson/rqbit) is embeddable as a library (librqbit crate) with an HTTP control/streaming API; GET /torrents/{id_or_infohash}/stream/{file_idx} supports Range headers, blocks until requested pieces are downloaded, and prioritizes pieces near the read cursor for seek-ahead streaming. No axum-specific integration documented, but the HTTP API shape (range-based file streaming) matches the existing /api/proxy relay pattern in this codebase.
